title: A small-bias generator with bounded size
statement: For every integer $n\ge1$ and every $0<\varepsilon\le1/2$, there is a positive integer $\ell$ such that the distribution generated by choosing two elements uniformly from the binary extension field of degree $\ell$ is $\varepsilon$-biased on the $n$-dimensional binary cube, and the multiset of generated strings has cardinality at most $16(n/\varepsilon)^2$.
